# IIceRules.BeamScale property

How thick the beam is, as a multiple of the game's: 1 by default, where the beam is drawn 25 units thick and reaches runners over the 10 units below its runner's top. The drawing and the reach grow around their own middle lines. The length is the game's, 2040 units.

public float BeamScale { get; set; }
